title: Rochdale wins gold and national Britain in Bloom town centre title
excerpt: Rochdale takes gold and the Town and City Centre category title at the national RHS awards, hosted at Rochdale Town Hall.
body:
Rochdale has won gold and been named Town and City Centre category winner at the RHS Britain in Bloom National Awards, with the celebrations taking place on home soil at Rochdale Town Hall.

The national recognition celebrates the work of Rochdale in Bloom and the people who care for the town’s public spaces throughout the year.

Volunteers, local businesses, Rochdale Town Centre BID and Rochdale Borough Council’s environmental management teams have all been credited in the announcement supplied to Rochdale Daily.

Their contribution goes beyond colourful planting. The announcement highlights community involvement, pride in the town and caring for nature as central to the achievement.

For those involved, winning the category as well as a gold award makes the result particularly special. Hosting this year’s national ceremony at Rochdale Town Hall added another reason to celebrate.

The award is a moment of national recognition for the collective effort behind Rochdale’s public spaces, and a chance to thank everyone whose time and work helped make it possible.
